protocol: 256 games, 4 frozen scripted opponents, balanced seats, fresh seed 555001, identical per candidate

external_gate.basis: pre 0.0742 vs post 0.2578, non-overlapping 95% intervals, >> 6.4pt reproducibility bound

selection_defect.note: the preregistered rule was followed exactly and was underpowered; it selected a checkpoint that is ~6pts weaker out of sample than the final

not_rerun: the transfer arms are NOT re-run with a different checkpoint -- choosing the checkpoint after seeing which makes the gate pass is gate-shopping
